records.title: Aalborg University International Student Scholarship (tuition fee waiver and monthly stipend)
records.deadline_display: All non-EU applicants are automatically considered when applying to a master's programme. Therefore, it is not possible to apply for a scholarship separately.

source.as_of: Scholarships section on the current master's Finance and fees page; stipend rate stated for 2026 (11,225 DKK / 1503 EUR per month)
source.raw_extract: All non-EU applicants are automatically considered when applying to a master’s programme. Therefore, it is not possible to apply for a scholarship separately. [...] When will the scholarships be granted? We will inform all applicants about the scholarship decision by the beginning of July at the latest, though it may be earlier. [...] Please note, Aalborg University only grants a limited number of scholarships - approximately 15 each year. [...] EU/EEA students cannot apply for scholarships at AAU.
source.exact_deadline_wording: All non-EU applicants are automatically considered when applying to a master’s programme. Therefore, it is not possible to apply for a scholarship separately.
source.notes: The shard's official_source_url https://www.en.aau.dk/education/finance/scholarships returns HTTP 404; the live official home of this scholarship is the master's 'Finance and fees' page, whose Scholarships section I fetched. AAU publishes no scholarship application deadline, because no separate scholarship application exists: consideration is automatic with the master's application. The only dates AAU publishes for this scholarship are a decision-notification timing ('by the beginning of July at the latest, though it may be earlier') and the tuition-fee payment deadline, which is a payment deadline rather than a scholarship deadline. The scholarship is also restricted to the September intake and to non-EU/EEA applicants. The only binding calendar date is the master's programme admissions deadline for fee-paying applicants (15 January 23:59 CET, September intake) on the official admissions page I fetched; that is a generic admissions deadline and per brief section 5 I deliberately did NOT import it as the scholarship deadline. Writing no date is the truthful result.

records.title: University of Oulu Early Bird Discount and Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarship
records.deadline_display: The discount is granted if the tuition fee is paid within three weeks of the admission results being published.

source.as_of: Page states it applies to students admitted during the autumn 2026 or spring 2027 admission rounds for studies beginning in the 2027-2028 academic year
source.raw_extract: The information on this page applies to students admitted during the autumn 2026 or spring 2027 admission rounds for studies beginning in the 2027-2028 academic year. [...] Early Bird discounts are available for selected degree programmes. The discount is granted if the tuition fee is paid within three weeks of the admission results being published. [...] Tuition fee waiver scholarships are available from the second year onwards. The scholarship is awarded based on successful progress in studies. To be eligible, students must complete at least 60 ECTS credits during the preceding academic year in accordance with their approved study plan, including the required Finnish language studies, which differ in scope between degree programmes.
source.exact_deadline_wording: The discount is granted if the tuition fee is paid within three weeks of the admission results being published.
source.notes: The shard's official_source_url was fetched. Neither component of this record has a datable calendar deadline. The Early Bird Discount is a payment-triggered benefit, not an application: it is granted if tuition is paid within three weeks AFTER the admission results are published, a condition that is event-relative and cannot be resolved to a calendar date from the page (the actual payment deadline is sent individually in the admission offer email). The Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarship is an automatic award from the second year onwards based on completing at least 60 ECTS credits in the preceding academic year, with programme-specific percentages (no 100% waivers). The page never uses the words 'rolling' or states a fixed deadline, so ROLLING was not asserted either, and per brief section 5 I deliberately did not import the linked Bachelor's/Master's admission deadlines pages, which are generic admissions deadlines for the application round rather than a scholarship deadline. No calendar date is derivable, so the truthful answer is UNKNOWN with a null date.

This cycle is genuinely upcoming relative to retrieval date 2026-10-05, so the date is written, not treated as expired.

records.title: Future Scientists Scholarship (منحة علماء المستقبل) 2026/2027 — Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research and Central Bank of Egypt
records.deadline_display: مد فترة التقديم لمنحة «علماء المستقبل» للعام الجامعي 2026/2027، حتى الساعة السابعة مساءً يوم الجمعة الموافق 4 سبتمبر 2026

source.publisher: State Information Service (الهيئة العامة للاستعلامات), Egypt - relaying the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research with the Central Bank of Egypt
source.as_of: News item dated ٠١ سبتمبر, ٢٠٢٦ (1 September 2026), 11:23 p.m.; extension of the application period for the 2026/2027 academic year
source.raw_extract: أعلنت وزارة التعليم العالي والبحث العلمي، بالتعاون مع البنك المركزي المصري، مد فترة التقديم لمنحة «علماء المستقبل» للعام الجامعي 2026/2027، حتى الساعة السابعة مساءً يوم الجمعة الموافق 4 سبتمبر 2026، وذلك لإتاحة مزيد من الوقت أمام الطلاب المستحقين لاستكمال إجراءات التقديم.
source.exact_deadline_wording: حتى الساعة السابعة مساءً يوم الجمعة الموافق 4 سبتمبر 2026
source.notes: English rendering of the quoted Arabic deadline sentence: the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research, in cooperation with the Central Bank of Egypt, extended the application period for the 'Future Scientists' scholarship for the 2026/2027 academic year until 7:00 p.m. on Friday 4 September 2026. That explicit date-time is in the past relative to retrieval date 2026-10-05, while the record is still open/upcoming, so per brief section 6 this is expired_mismatch: the date is recorded as evidence only and is NOT written to deadline_date. The page also names the official application link (https://futurescholars.mohesr.gov.eg/) but does not announce a further round, so nothing was rolled forward. The pre-existing catalogue display also referenced an earlier deadline of 2 September 2026, 17:00; this official page states only the extended closing time, so that earlier value remains unverified and was not used.
